name: גָּלָל
gloss: meaning not given; perhaps “rolling” or “rolled (on Yahweh)”
summary: Two Levites among those who lived in Jerusalem after the return: one named with Bakbakkar, Heresh and Mattaniah (1Ch 9:15), and Galal son of Jeduthun, grandfather of Obadiah (Abda), of the singers' line (1Ch 9:16; Neh 11:17). The name is the root's own consonants, like the noun גָּלָל; scripture does not explain it, and whether it means “rolling” or one “rolled onto Yahweh” (Psa 37:5) is only a reading.

evidence.note: “Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.”
“Abda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.”
“Roll your way upon Yahweh”: the verb, if the name means “committed”.

note: TIPNR keeps two people, Galal@1Ch.9.15 and Galal@1Ch.9.16; Neh 11:17 is the second. The meaning is a reading of the form only; no verse gives it.
